Leaving the apn field empty in a GTP APN traffic shaping policy means that the policy will not match any traffic. Consequently, APN traffic shaping can only be applied to specific APNs. To configure GTP APN traffic shaping: config gtp apn-shaper edit <policy-id> set apn [<apn-name> <apngrp-name> ...] set rate-limit <limit> set action {drop | reject} set back-off-time <time> next end

For previous versions of hyperscale FortiOS, FGCP HA clustering with hardware session synchronization with config vcluster-status disabled allowed you to monitor hw-session-sync-dev interfaces. FortiOS 7.6.3 changed this behavior, and you can no longer monitor hw-session-sync-dev interfaces. When upgrading to FortiOS 7.6.3 if your HA configuration includes monitoring hw-session-sync-dev interfaces, the upgrade will fail.
observations.workaround: Before performing the upgrade, remove monitoring from hw-session-sync-dev interfaces, or select different interfaces to be hw-session-sync-dev interfaces.

observations.description: After upgrade, event log shows logdesc="IPSA driver update failed" msg="Fail to update IPSA driver status!". This issue only affects physical FortiGate models with the following IPS engine versions: IPS Engine version: 7.550 - 7.567 IPS Engine version: 7.1019 - 7.1039 To determine the IPS Engine versions, use the command: get sys fortiguard-service status | grep 'IPS/FlowAV Engine'
observations.workaround: Power off the FortiGate. Wait 30 seconds, and then power on the FortiGate. Note: Reboot using the CLI is not an effective workaround and requires additional steps. After executing exec shutdown, unplug the power to the FortiGate. Wait one minute, and the power on the FortiGate.

The firewall policy works with proxy-based inspection mode on FortiGate models with 2GB RAM after an upgrade.
observations.workaround: After an upgrade, reboot the FortiGate.

observations.description: High CPU usage occurs when proxy-based inspection mode is enabled and udp-not-quic traffic is allowed
observations.workaround: Set udp-not-quic to block in firewall ssl-ssh-profile.

observations.description: The router API does not include all ECMP routes for SD-WAN included in the get router info routing-table command.
An error message appears in FortiGate when attempting to add the ssl.root interface to a route-map via the GUI.
The Security Rating topology and results does not display non-FortiGate devices.
An interface in FortiLink is flapping with an MCLAG FortiSwitch using DAC on an OPSFPP-T-05-PAB transceiver.
FortiSwitch units are offline after FortiGate is upgraded from 7.4.6 or 7.6.0 to 7.6.1 or later when LLDP configuration is set to vdom/disable under the FortiLink interface.
observations.workaround: In LLDP configuration, enable lldp-reception and lldp-transmission under the FortiLink interface, or rebuild the FortiLink interface.

observations.description: FortiSwitch port configurations fail to update and GUI display issues occur when user-info process overloads system resources with excessive connections.
Traffic flow speed is reduced or interrupted when the traffic shaper is enabled.
Some FortiGate models experience unexpected interface down time when using DAC cables after upgrade due to improper Signal-OK loss detection.
FortiGate Cloud remote login triggers 2 admin login events (1 successful and 1 unsuccessful for PKI admin).
Enabling "device-identification" also gets endpoint information even though an intermediate router exists on FortiGate and endpoints.
After a FortiOS upgrade, an error condition occurs when update daemon tries to update the databases while CMDB is still loading the JSON file at the same time.

When performing LDAP user searches from the GUI against LDAP servers with a large number of users (more than 100000), FortiGate may experience a performance issue and not operate as expected due to the HTTPSD process consuming too much memory. User may need to stop the HTTPSD process or perform a reboot to recover.
observations.workaround: Perform an LDAP user search using the CLI.

observations.description: Custom NAS-ID not sent to RADIUS server when testing connectivity via GUI.
Agentless FSSO connector issues occur when using Windows 2025 due to MS introduced additional restrictions to remote Event log reading.
AWS bootstrap is unable to properly parse IAM role profile due to the length.
FFW_VM License validation fails when FortiManager is configured as a license server
The device encounters an issue where options in the ftgd-wf section cannot be unset when configuring a web filter via an Ansible playbook
